targets.finding: 2025 10-K states two specifying customers drove 12% and 10% of consolidated revenue and one additional direct purchasing customer accounted for 19% including certain revenue specified by others. At year-end, two primarily Semiconductor Test customers represented about 22% and 20% of accounts receivable.
targets.gateImpact: resolves TER concentration sub-gate; cash/debt and governance/dilution remain separate gates

targets.finding: As of Dec. 31 2025 Rockwell reported $671m commercial paper at 3.89% weighted-average interest and 32-day weighted-average maturity. Sensia's $75m unsecured line had matured/closed with no borrowings outstanding; outstanding debt had been settled with loans from the JV partners. This supersedes the Sep. 30 2025 snapshot showing $522m commercial paper and $70m Sensia line borrowing.
targets.gateImpact: resolves the enumerated debt/liquidity and Sensia-capital sub-gate at the newer filing date; concentration remains separate

targets.finding: 2025 10-K states Intel held about 79.5% of outstanding common stock and 97.3% of voting power at Dec. 27 2025 via Class A plus all Class B shares; after the Mentee Robotics share issuance, Intel beneficially owned about 77.0% of outstanding common and 96.9% voting power as of Feb. 3 2026. The dual-class 10-to-1 vote structure allows Intel to control stockholder matters.
targets.gateImpact: resolves MBLY Intel/control/governance sub-gate; major-customer concentration remains separate
